messages:
product-lead: Quick announcement: StreamBridge Compact (streambridge.compact) and SlimGuard models are GA today. This is a lightweight streaming profile optimized for low-bandwidth clients and mobile SDKs. It supports token-streaming, compact embeddings (quantized 8/4-bit), and granular tool-call frames so clients can react to tool outputs without waiting for full payloads. Internal docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/streambridge-compact (internal).

product-lead: Summary bullets: 1) New model family: `slimguard-v2` (fast small-context mode + compact embeddings). 2) Endpoint: `streambridge.compact` for interleaved tokens, tool-frames, and compact-embeds. 3) SDK shim in py/js for mobile-friendly perf. 4) Pricing: lower per-token tier for compact streams; compact-embeddings billed at 60% of standard. 5) Deprecation: legacy `/v1/stream-lite` is deprecated in 75 days; 30-day auto-forwarding available.

devx: Migration example (python):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
# request compact streaming with tool frames and compact embedding
resp = client.streambridge.compact(model='slimguard-v2', input='Analyze mobile logs', stream=True, compact_embed=True)
for frame in resp:
    if frame['frame_type'] == 'token':
        sys.stdout.write(frame['data'])
    elif frame['frame_type'] == 'tool_call':
        handle_tool(frame['tool'], frame['result'])
    elif frame['frame_type'] == 'embed':
        save_compact_embedding(frame['vector'])
```
JS snippet (old -> new):
```js
// old: client.streamLite.create({model, input})
// new: client.streambridge.compact({model:'slimguard-v2', input, stream:true, compactEmbed:true})
```
No auth changes; SDK minor bumps only. We added helper decoders for compact-embed formats in the mobile SDKs.

infra-deploy-bot: infra-deploy-bot: Canary schedule: start=2112352800, rollout stages=2%->20%->60%->100% over ~5h, rollback-window=90m. Canary keys in secrets/streambridge/compact/canary/* . Watch signals: compact-embed-decode-errors, stream-disconnect-rate, tool-frame-latency.

oncall: Observability: Console -> Models -> slimguard-v2 has dedicated p50/p95/p99 latency, disconnect-rate, and compact-embed-decode-success. Added alert: streambridge-compact-error-rate (>0.5% across 5m) and toolframe-latency-p95. Oncall rotation tagged for 48h.

sales: Early-adopter promotion: first 10k stream-seconds free per customer for 60 days. Need collateral for pricing page; product-lead will send copy.

legal: Data handling note: compact-embeds are reversible for debug only in the hosted tier and are retained for 30 days by default. Customers who require non-reversible embeddings must use Dedicated/Private or opt-out of embedding retention in account settings. All exports and debug dumps require explicit consent ticket.

data-privacy: Privacy reminder: compact embeddings are treated as PII-sensitive if paired with metadata. Default retention 30 days; enterprise exceptions require signed addendum. Please route requests through privacy@redwood.ai.

product-lead: Deprecation timeline: cutover timestamp for `/v1/stream-lite` -> 2112401678 (75 days). Warnings will be surfaced in SDK logs 21 days prior and in Console 14 days prior. Auto-forwarding will be available for 30 days post-deprecation. If partners need extended grace, open a request with integrations.

devx: Known gotchas: mobile clients must call the new helper `decode_compact_embed()` to expand compact vectors to float32 if needed; this is available in py/js SDKs and the mobile bindings. Also, chunking defaults to 80ms for compact streams; tune via `stream_hint_ms`.

product-lead: Launch readout + runbook walk-through in #release-war-room today 16:30 PT. Please RSVP if you're owning monitoring, support triage, or partner communications. Huge thanks to infra/devx/privacy/legal/sales for the quick turnaround. :rocket:
